primary_window.end: earliest date of maximum positive observed WTEQ in the water year inclusive
primary_window.coverage: require complete observation, climate, and trace coverage from start through observed peak
primary_window.aggregation: compute annual values first, then Python statistics.median by site; pooled hours/days are secondary exposure-weighted views only

thermal_classification.eligible_hour: interval-start active pack or positive hourly snowfall, with finite hourly air temperature
thermal_classification.cold_day: maximum eligible hourly air temperature <= 0 C
thermal_classification.mixed_day: minimum eligible hourly air temperature <= 0 C and maximum > 0 C
thermal_classification.warm_day: minimum eligible hourly air temperature > 0 C
thermal_classification.exhaustiveness: each eligible day is exactly one of cold_day, mixed_day, warm_day

dry_period_operator.daily_eligibility: fixture all-phase precipitation <= 0.000254 m and guarded observed PREC increment <= 0.000254 m; never bridge missing dates or water-year resets
dry_period_operator.grouping: maximal consecutive eligible days, minimum 3 days, clipped to primary window
dry_period_operator.observed_loss: max(WTEQ at interval start minus WTEQ at interval end, 0)
dry_period_operator.predecessor_comparison: same site, water year, start, and end key against the retained 21J dry-interval table

coe_attribution.identity: applied_melt = amelt + bmelt + cmelt + dmelt + cap_adjustment within tolerance
coe_attribution.reporting: signed and positive-only empirical melt-depth totals by thermal class; never label values measured energy shares
coe_attribution.association: annual Spearman and Pearson association of positive applied melt and pack loss, reported only with counts
coe_attribution.dominance: largest positive empirical component is descriptive and not causal authority

stage3_attribution.chronology: downstream response after CoE melt and snow-contact rain
stage3_attribution.prohibition: do not use Stage-3 energy to assign upstream CoE melt causation

snowbird_pairing.required_identity: all non-precipitation climate tokens are identical
snowbird_pairing.primary_response: annual pre-peak pack-loss difference and observed-date/within-window SWE difference
snowbird_pairing.state_signal: at least 10 paired years, median absolute pack-loss difference >= 0.01 m, and at least 75% of nonzero annual differences share one direction
snowbird_pairing.role: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY input sensitivity; never canonical acceptance

adjudication.warm_mixed_site_signal: at least 10 eligible years, median annual warm+mixed share of pre-peak pack loss >= 0.6, and at least 75% of annual shares >= 0.5
adjudication.systemic_warm_mixed: warm_mixed_site_signal at at least 3 canonical sites
